title: API handshake visual vignette set for onboarding: auth, streaming, and live tool calls
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a compact set of visual vignettes and annotated screenshots for the API/SDK quickstart that clearly illustrate the authentication handshake, API key lifecycle, streaming response flow, and live tool/function calling. Deliverables include static screens, 3x micro-animated GIFs (light + dark variants), and an accessible alt-text pack for docs.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Figma file contains a single page with labelled frames for: auth handshake, key rotation, streaming SSE snippet, and tool call lifecycle
A2: Three exported GIFs (auth-handshake.gif, streaming-flow.gif, tool-invoke.gif) at 800x450 and 480x270 with light and dark theme variants
A3: Annotated screenshots (PNG) with callouts for SDK lines that matter and copy-ready captions for docs
A4: Accessibility pack includes short descriptive alt-text for each visual and color-contrast checksheet
A5: Handoff folder includes a design spec, export tokens, and a single GitHub PR reference for docs inclusion
